4.reason: firewalld with the default public zone blocks kubelet (10250), NodePort (30000-32767), and CNI overlay traffic. Nothing in the role opens these ports.
4.note: TKE worker nodes are fronted by a Tencent Security Group, which is the enforced network boundary.

rhel10cis_selinux_enforce.reason: SELinux enforcing may block containerd/kubelet without validated contexts (needs container-selinux).

rhel10cis_is_router.reason: Primary lever to keep IPv4+IPv6 forwarding on for kube-proxy/CNI.
